title: Share Task activity across a repository's worktrees
statement: As a developer running agents in separate worktrees of one repository, what one agent reports is visible from every other worktree straight away, with nothing committed

acceptance_criteria.statement: Activity recorded in one worktree of a repository reads back from any other, and from a Saga kept apart from its code with --repo
Several processes appending at once lose no event, and a torn last line is skipped rather than failing the read
Each agent's log rotates at a fixed size, and logs nobody has written to for a month are removed
